title: Samsung and Qualcomm Dispute Snapdragon 8 Elite Issues
excerpt: Samsung internal testing reportedly reveals overheating and performance problems with the new Qualcomm processor, but Qualcomm disputes the findings.
body_html:
During internal evaluations, Samsung reportedly uncovered significant performance and overheating troubles involving Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chip.

The testing phase highlighted concerns regarding sustained performance levels under load. However, Qualcomm has contested these reported findings, disputing the claims made about its processor.
